cards.title: Exam answer plan: methods of colonial rule
cards.problem: Compare British and French methods of colonial rule.

steps.text: British **indirect rule**: governed through traditional chiefs (e.g. Northern Nigeria).
French **direct rule** and **assimilation**: French officials governed; Africans were expected to adopt French culture.

cards.answer: Both exploited African land, labour and resources for the colonial power.
